arxiv-2504-03407.title: Time-integration of Gaussian variational approximation for the magnetic Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2504-03407.creator: Malik Scheifinger, Kurt Busch, Marlis Hochbruck, Caroline Lasser
arxiv-2504-03407.description: Abstract In the present paper we consider the semiclassical magnetic Schrödinger equation, which describes the dynamics of charged particles under the influence of a electro-magnetic field. arxiv-2508-01517.creator:
ame Ziwei Su \email ziwei.su@northwestern.edu, 
ame Imon Banerjee \email imon.banerjee@northwestern.edu, 
ame Diego Klabjan \email d-klabjan@northwestern.edu
arxiv-2508-01517.description: Abstract We develop a central limit theorem (CLT) for the non-parametric estimator of the transition matrices in controlled Markov chains (CMCs) with finite state-action spaces. Our results establish precise conditions on the logging policy under which the estimator is asymptotically normal, and reveal settings in which no CLT can exist.
